Explicit atom-power reduction supplies polynomial-size constant-depth Booleanity certificates for U_i=1-ML(S_i^(p-1)) when S_i is a sum of squarefree products of atoms whose supports are disjoint after duplicate identification, with atoms variables or disjunction polynomials. Aggregate products preserve this certificate class. This recovers the cited p>=5 knapsack family's advertised unrestricted upper bound with all Boolean corrections; it gives no binary lower-bound progress.
